_note: Where to look for each market's photograph. scripts/probe-skylines.mjs reads this from the GitHub runner, where Commons is reachable; the sandbox that edits it is not. `wikipedia` names the articles whose own images are the curated shortlist (a city article's lead image has been argued over by people who care which photograph represents the place). `categories` names hand-filed Commons categories to try — the naming is inconsistent between cities, so several shapes are listed and the run reports which exist. `queries` is the last door, full-text search. Run with --search to gather, with no flag to verify the files already chosen. Promotion into lib/skyline.ts is by hand, because that is where the attribution obligation is taken on.
